sections.title: Overview
sections.content: AP Discount is a Pictos in Clair Obscur: Expedition 33. Effect: Reduces the AP cost of skills.

sections.title: How to Get AP Discount
sections.content: Location: Verso's Drafts - Reverie Path merchant, 217,000 Chroma.

sections.title: Is It Worth Equipping?
sections.content: Pictos unlock a Lumina after four battles, so equipping it once is enough to keep the effect permanently available for the Lumina cost.
